answer: An agent marketplace requires every identity voting on contract disputes to lock $100 in escrow for 90 days, with one vote per funded identity. Agents trading copper, tracking raven migrations, or forecasting orchard yields follow the same rule. Creating names is free, but buying 1,000 votes ties up $100,000 for three months. Splitting funds among aliases creates no extra voting power per dollar, so a sybil attacker pays a capital and liquidity cost.
